name: Rhoda
role: Servant girl who left Peter at the gate
whenBasis: Herod Agrippa I's persecution, shortly before his death in AD 44 (Acts 12:1, 23).
summary: A servant girl in the house of Mary, John Mark's mother, where the church was praying for Peter's release. When Peter knocked at the outer gate, she recognised his voice and was so overjoyed that she forgot to open it, and ran in to say Peter was at the gate. They told her she was out of her mind, then that it must be his angel, while Peter kept on knocking.
